policy.validity_instant: For an individual bundle, anchor valid_from/valid_until are evaluated only at the signed identity-attestation issued_at instant; current wall-clock time is irrelevant to revalidation.
policy.parser_binding: Every active anchor/edition rule must bind an exact parser profile id and SHA-256 listed in the exact retained ISO3166 parser registry bytes used by the release.
policy.note: No individual PatentGrantBundle may satisfy ISO 3166 jurisdiction authentication until this reviewed registry contains at least one cryptographic trust anchor demonstrably issued or controlled by ISO for the relevant artifact-signing purpose and bound to an exact reviewed parser profile. HTTPS origin, repository maintainer attestation, unsigned downloaded bytes, self-described edition metadata, or an implementation-local parser are not sufficient.
